title: Tactical go-to-market runway and release-notes handoff
creator: Maya Chen
description: Orchestrate coordinated external announcement across blog, customer email, social, and a product webinar. This ticket owns the runway (timeline + gating), canonical release-notes copy, and the handoff playbook for Marketing, Support, and Sales. Objective: reduce last-mile churn between documentation and product behavior, avoid mismatched claims, and ensure a single source of truth for release-notes and assets. Scope covers: finalizing release-notes doc, approving hero blog draft, scheduling segmented customer emails, social asset pack, webinar script and rehearsals, translation handoff, and post-launch metrics collection.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical release-notes (Markdown) published to Drive and linked from Console release page
Blog post approved by Product, Legal, and Design and scheduled in CMS with embargo set
Customer email segments created and scheduled in HubSpot with QA send complete
Social assets (3 formats) uploaded to shared Drive and scheduled in Buffer/TweetDeck
Webinar registration page live and rehearsal completed 48 hours before launch
Support playbook and canned responses drafted and reviewed in Notion
At least one rollback/mitigation plan documented and owners assigned
